phrases.demand: Google autocomplete: 'instagram alternative' -> 'for photographers', 'for artists', 'reddit' (all top-10 suggestions); 'instagram alternative for photographers' -> '...reddit', 'best ...'. Strongest demand signal found.
phrases.competition: Roundups on TechRadar, PetaPixel, Digital Camera World, DIYPhotography, Fstoppers, Shotkit, IONOS, Digital Trends, Pixsy. All big publishers; a new brand wins by being LISTED in these, not by outranking them. Product sites (Glass, Pixelfed, 500px, Flickr) are inside the lists.

phrases.phrase: bluesky instagram alternative / bluesky photo app
phrases.demand: Autocomplete: 'bluesky instagram' -> 'alternative', 'app', 'version', 'clone', 'vs instagram for artists'; 'bluesky photo app' -> 'bluesky photo sharing app'. Small but real and growing.
phrases.competition: Winnable. Results dominated by Flashes (TechCrunch, PetaPixel, Engadget, Gizmodo) plus Pinksky and Skygram. No big brand owns it; a dedicated landing page + a few press hits could take it.

phrases.phrase: social media for tattoo artists / best social media platform for tattoo artists
phrases.demand: Autocomplete: 5 suggestions ('best social media platform for tattoo artists', 'marketing', 'strategy').
phrases.competition: Mostly small agency/marketing blogs. Weak competition, niche, good seed-user phrase.

phrases.phrase: social network for artists / artist portfolio app
phrases.demand: 'social network for artists' -> 'best social network for artists'; 'portfolio for artists' has 10 suggestions (website, template, app, free); 'artist portfolio app' present.
phrases.competition: Behance, ArtStation, Cara, DeviantArt, Squarespace/Wix/Format template pages. Portfolio-builder terms are strong brands; 'artist social network' is mid-strength (Cara leads anti-AI angle).

phrases.phrase: protect my photos from being stolen / how to stop people stealing photos
phrases.demand: Autocomplete returned nothing for exact phrasing; 'someone stole my photo(s)' -> facebook/instagram/ebay variants. Demand exists as how-to content, not as a product query.
phrases.competition: PetaPixel, DIYPhotography, Pixsy, Pixpa, Zenfolio, Lightstalking, ipwatchdog. Advice-article game; Pixsy owns the commercial intent. Winnable only with an original guide/tool page, not the homepage.

phrases.phrase: copyright takedown / DMCA takedown for photographers
phrases.demand: No autocomplete returned for photographer-specific phrasing; commercial intent is high (DMCA.com $199 per takedown).
phrases.competition: Pixsy, Copytrack, DMCA.com, DoNotPay, CVBER; SourceForge/affiliate roundups. Pixsy is the entrenched brand. Free automatic takedown is a differentiator but ranking for the head term is hard.

phrases.phrase: photo sharing app / photo sharing sites for photographers
phrases.demand: Autocomplete: 'photo sharing app' -> 8 suggestions incl. 'for photographers', 'sites for photographers', 'sites like flickr'.
phrases.competition: Flickr, Google Photos, Dropbox, SmugMug, Pixieset; huge brands. Head term not winnable; the 'for photographers' long tail is via roundups.

phrases.phrase: prove I took this photo / content credentials / C2PA
phrases.demand: 'content credentials' -> verify, adobe, c2pa, lightroom, photoshop, remove (real demand, tech-leaning). 'prove i took this photo' returned nothing.
phrases.competition: Adobe, contentauthenticity.org, c2pa.org, Leica/Sony/Nikon pages. Brand-owned, but 'content credentials' + social network is an open niche. Small apps already here: SignedShot, ProofMark, Capture Cam (capture-only, no network).

phrases.phrase: social media without bots / no algorithm social media
phrases.demand: Autocomplete returned nothing for these exact phrasings (Reddit/long-tail queries, not suggested).
phrases.competition: Not assessed deeply; likely Mastodon, Bluesky, BeReal, Pixelfed pages. Use as page copy, not as a name target.

phrases.demand: Autocomplete: 8 suggestions (client, app, github, mod, downloader).
phrases.competition: GitHub repos, Pixelfed, Instagram scraper tools. Mixed intent; Pixelfed wins the 'app' reading.

names.name: Folioproof
names.phrase: portfolio for artists + proof of authorship
names.why: 'folio' catches the portfolio searches, 'proof' says your work is signed; one coined word, zero existing results.

names.name: Frameproof
names.phrase: protect my photos from being stolen
names.why: Frame = photo, proof = verified. Reads as a promise. Neighbours: Frameclaim (content protection, different name), SmartFrame.

names.name: Stillproof
names.phrase: prove I took this photo / content credentials
names.why: 'Still' = a photograph; zero search results so first-ranker for its own name. Loses illustrators and video slightly.

names.name: Photosky
names.why: Directly contains 'photo' + 'sky' for 'bluesky photo app' queries; very close to Pinksky/Skygram so confusable.

names.name: Bluefolio
names.why: Blue (Bluesky) + folio (portfolio). Only generic hits (junk-journal kits, templates). Sounds like a portfolio site, not a social network.

names.name: Copyproof
names.why: Says copyright protection in one word. .org taken, .com taken; many 'copyright app' competitors make it crowded.
names.conflict: No app of this name found; field of similar tools is crowded (Marksta, PhotoProof, Capture Cam)

names.name: Shotby
names.why: 'Shot by <you>' is the photographer credit line, so every post is a signature; ties to the proof-of-author hook. Only unrelated golf app 'ShotByShot' (archived).

names.name: Drawnby
names.why: 'Drawn by <you>' is the illustrator credit; pairs with Shotby if you want a family. 'Drawn by' is a weak phrase to rank on, but the one-word name has no competitor.

names.name: Inkedby
names.why: 'Inked by <artist>' is how clients tag tattoo work. Directly targets the weakest-competition phrase. Narrow, so poor for photographers.
names.conflict: Nearby but different: Inkedin Tools, The Inked Network (tattoo booking apps)

names.name: Ownshot
names.phrase: protect my photos from being stolen
names.why: 'Your own shot' = ownership + authorship, welcoming not hostile. No product found.

names.name: Whomade
names.phrase: prove I took this photo / content credentials
names.why: Answers the question every stolen-art repost raises: who made this. No product; WhoMadeWho is a Danish band so may split brand searches.

names.name: Signedframe
names.why: Signed + frame = every post is signed. Only candidate with .com free. Close to SignedShot (open-source authenticity camera app, different name).
names.conflict: SignedShot (photo authenticity app; similar, different name)

names.name: Atproof
names.phrase: bluesky photo app / AT Protocol proof
names.why: AT Protocol + proof. Nerdy, but owns 'atproto + proof' searches and signals the protocol to developers. Not welcoming to non-technical creators.

names.name: Hallmarked
names.phrase: content credentials / proof of who made it
names.why: A hallmark is the maker's stamp on silver; warm, craft meaning. Real word so hard to rank for the bare term; 'hallmarked app' query only returns watermark apps.
names.conflict: None found for this exact name; 'Hallmark' brand is very strong

names.name: Truemade
names.why: 'Authentic photo' has autocomplete demand; true + made = verified creator. Not a dictionary word. Neighbours: Truest, TruShot (different names).

names.name: Skysnap
names.why: Sky (Bluesky) + snap (photo); friendly and short. SkySnap is a Warsaw drone/satellite imagery company, so conflict in search results.
